name: RC-B10-0284/2025/REV1 – § 4 – Am 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Dr Ahmadreza Djalali in Iran
part_text: 4. Calls on Sweden and* *other relevant Member States and the European External Action Service to intensify diplomatic efforts and adopt targeted measures in response to Iran’s continued detention of EU nationals, including Cécile Kohler, Jacques Paris and others, as part of its hostage diplomacy and in violation of international law;
